title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.17831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across publ

translated_title: Diff Diffusion：利用扩散模型预测编辑路径以实现高效代码编辑
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型因其能够并行更新多个token而在代码生成中颇具吸引力，但许多此类模型是针对序列合成而非编辑预测进行优化的。这一设定与现代AI辅助IDE的需求严重不匹配——在这类IDE中，编辑预测必须根据最近的编辑、当前文件以及光标局部上下文来推断下一次代码变更。此类变更通常是稀疏的，并且会保留大部分源代码token，因此重新生成完整的代码段会浪费计算资源。我们提出了Diff Diffusion，这是一个受扩散启发的LLM代码编辑框架，用于预测从原始代码片段到其修订形式的编辑路径。Diff Diffusion将去噪过程表示为结构化的编辑操作，并将这一建模方式与多阶段训练和高效并行解码相结合。通过将计算集中在变更区域，Diff Diffusion支持精确的低延迟编辑以及多位点并行修改。在已发表的...
tldr: 提出Diff Diffusion框架，将扩散模型的去噪过程表示为结构化编辑操作，通过将计算集中于代码变更区域并结合多阶段训练与并行解码，实现精确、低延迟且支持多位点并行修改的代码编辑预测。
en_tdlr: Diff Diffusion is a diffusion-inspired LLM framework that represents denoising as structured edit operations and focuses computation on changed regions, enabling accurate, low-latency code editing with multi-position parallel modification.
